entities.name: Protocadherin beta-11
observations: The 768-residue query sequence is a 100% identity, full-length match to reviewed human protocadherin beta-11 (UniProt Q9Y5F2).
Predicted architecture is a secretory-pathway N-terminus, six extracellular cadherin-like repeats, one C-terminal transmembrane helix, and a short cytoplasmic tail.
Curated homolog annotations describe a potential calcium-dependent cell-adhesion protein involved in establishing and maintaining specific neuronal connections.

entities.name: Classical cadherin repeat
observations: Pfam detects one Cadherin_2 domain at residues 31–112, five Cadherin domains at residues 141–661, and a Cadherin_C_2 region at residues 685–768.
Cadherin repeats support calcium-dependent extracellular adhesion; sequence homology supports this interpretation but does not by itself establish binding specificity.

entities.name: Neuronal cell adhesion
observations: Related curated annotations include calcium-dependent cell-cell adhesion, homophilic cell-cell adhesion, synapse assembly, chemical synaptic transmission, and nervous system development.

entities.name: Plasma membrane
observations: The protein is annotated as a single-pass type I membrane protein at the cell membrane and plasma membrane; synaptic localization is reported in curated GO annotations.
